name: @guardbee/mcp-model-scanner
description: MCP server that scans ML model files (PyTorch, pickle, joblib, dill, NumPy, safetensors, Keras, ONNX, GGUF, TensorFlow) and Hugging Face repos for supply-chain risks — malicious pickle gadgets, disguised or malformed headers, Keras Lambda-layer RCE, GGUF chat-template injection, and graph ops that touch files
long_description: Scans a single model file or an entire directory for supply-chain risks specific to ML model file formats. Disassembles pickle opcode streams (including inside PyTorch's zip checkpoint container) to flag dangerous global references — os, subprocess, eval, socket, and other modules that have no place in tensor deserialization but are the classic gadget for turning `torch.load()`/`pickle.load()` into arbitrary code execution. Validates .safetensors header structure and detects files disguised with a safe-looking extension. Flags Keras Lambda-layer RCE patterns in .h5/.keras files, external_data path-traversal references in .onnx files, joblib/dill/NumPy object-array pickles, malformed GGUF headers and chat templates that escape the Jinja sandbox or carry hidden instructions, and TensorFlow SavedModel/GraphDef/TFLite ops that read or write files or call Python. Scans a Hugging Face repo at a pinned commit with scan_hf_repo. No API key required — local files never leave the machine.
